title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: Timer T3485
entities.description: Timer used during default EPS bearer context activation procedure. Controls retransmission of ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST messages.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by MME to activate default EPS bearer context.

entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered when bearer context becomes inactive.

entities.name: Timer T3485 expiry
entities.description: Condition triggered when timer T3485 expires.

entities.name: HeNB rejection of default bearer establishment
entities.description: Condition where Home eNodeB rejects default bearer establishment for LIPA PDN connection or SIPTO at local network PDN connection due to triggered handover.

entities.name: Resource release
entities.description: Property where MME releases allocated resources for activation.

entities.name: Procedure abort
entities.description: Property where MME aborts the activation procedure.

relations.description: Timer T3485 expiry triggers retransmission of ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.
On first expiry of T3485, the timer is reset and restarted.
Fifth expiry of T3485 establishes resource release.
Fifth expiry of T3485 establishes procedure abort.
HeNB rejection establishes BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE state.
